_note: P1 constants. Every entry: value (null = inactive), unit, source_kind, source_ref. fixture_declared values parameterise synthetic fixtures only and never touch real data. assumed_unmeasured values are placeholders the human has not measured; every output that uses one says so. config/ is the human's, so this file lives with the code that reads it.

ortho_image_size_px.source_ref: same canvas size as the O-mature renders (512 px)

ortho_mm_per_px.source_ref: 205 mm field of view; O-mature plant spread fits with margin

min_visible_px.source_ref: same visibility floor as the R.1 side-view labels (labels.json min_visible_px 150)

capture_interval_h.source_ref: two captures per day (phynotype2 spec section 1)

fixture_time_since_lights_on_min.source_ref: declared fixture clock; real lights-on time is unrecorded

tray_pitch_mm.source_ref: tray-to-tray spacing never measured (env_light_20261010.json grid.cell_spacing_cm = null)

pot_pitch_mm.source_ref: pot-to-pot spacing within a tray row never measured

soil_level_z_mm.source_ref: all pots assumed at one soil height; pot heights per slot unrecorded

canopy_frame.definition: canopy_mm: origin at the centre of grid cell row 1 / col 1 (tray1, wall-side pot row) at soil level; +X from grid col 1 toward col 4 (right end by the post -> left end, seen from the front); +Y from row 1 (wall) toward row 4 (front); +Z up. Right-handed. Layout source: data/records/env_light_20261010/env_light_20261010.json (rule v3, user_stated/user_confirmed).

side_from_front_offset_sign._note: L pot of a row sits toward +X (the viewer's left = toward col 4) by half a pot pitch; R toward -X

candidate_pool_max_per_track.source_ref: generator compounds drawn from other fixture scenes (fixed seeds)

coverage_tolerance.source_ref: a kept candidate must cover this fraction of the observed visible pixels (rasterisation tolerance)

generator_n_samples.source_ref: P1 fix A4: build_compound (numpy backend) samples per observed compound, seeds 0..n-1

extent_slack_rel.source_ref: phynotype2 completion.extent_slack_rel (null there): observed lateral reach widened for the generator extent contract (flat outline is wider than its projection)

refine_top.source_ref: P1 fix A4: best samples given the local rotation/scale fit

refine_yaw_deg.source_ref: P1 fix A4: rigid rotation offsets about the stem

refine_scale.source_ref: P1 fix A4: uniform scale factors after distal alignment (bounded so a candidate cannot inflate to cover)

monte_carlo_draws.source_ref: P1 T6: number of seeded draws propagating click uncertainty to mm_per_px; not a physical value

cross_check_stop_rel.source_ref: same T6.4 (differ by more than 5 % -> stop and report)

pose_self_check_k_sigma.source_ref: P1 side rim pose Y2: a pose is 'validated' when both two-axis self-check residuals lie within this many Monte-Carlo standard deviations of the stated click uncertainty (statistical band, not a physical threshold)
